exp.role: Product Designer / 3D Materials Artist · Visual Innovation Team
exp.desc:
Part of pilot projects for cross-functional CX design for Nike Trail, Kate Spade and Canyon Bikes, improving feature adoption by 25% and strengthening visual consistency across Amazon Fashion.
Developed AI-generated product summary and multilingual videos, reducing manual production effort by 50% while improving delivery consistency.
Built automated texture/material systems that increased rendering accuracy and accelerated 3D production cycles by 40%.
Introduced procedural texturing workflows that cut manual repetition and reduced asset production hours by 30–40%, accelerating delivery for high-volume sequences.
exp.ach: Global Hackathon – Top 2 Finalist · Wall of Fame Honoree

exp.desc:
Designed 50+ brand logos and visual identities aligned with business strategy, brand positioning and market objectives for diverse client portfolios.
Produced high-quality video advertisements, motion graphics and compositing work for digital marketing, social media campaigns and promotional content using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and Premiere Pro, ensuring brand consistency and strong audience engagement.
Collaborated with creative and marketing teams to deliver compelling visual narratives and storytelling that elevated brand presence and impact across digital platforms.
Built a strong foundation in 2D & 3D design, graphic design, and the end-to-end UI/UX design process through four years of academic training.
